description: Link an existing audience to a campaign. Each audience can belong to at most one campaign. This is idempotent — calling it again for an already-linked pair is safe. Fails with AUDIENCE_ALREADY_LINKED (naming current_campaign_id) if the audience is already in a different campaign — unlink it there first. Requires 'creator' scope.
